description: Epsilon zero is the supremum of the strictly increasing towers; each lies below it.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.tower_spec.{u} :
  StrictMono Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.tower ∧
    ⨆ n, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.tower n = Ordinal.epsilon 0 ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.tower n < Ordinal.epsilon 0) ∧
        ∀ (a : Ordinal.{u}), a < Ordinal.epsilon 0 ↔ ∃ n, a < Lemmatheca.SetTheory.NormalFunctions.tower n
